description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 5th-level spells, Spell Focus (Enfeebling)

Benefit: As long as you have an enfeebling spell of 5th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 5 MP in your MP pool, you can make another creature's spellcasting harmful to itself with a melee touch attack, causing the target to take damage each time it completes casting a spell. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting enfeebling spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 5th-level spells, Spell Focus (Enfeebling)
